items.title: 67848_Jimmy McPartland oral history interview
items.q: Joscho Heifetz was there with he (married?) was it Florence (Vidar?), I think Joscho Heifetz (Mary, Mary?).

ctx.x: He wasn't exactly a poor boy then?

No, he wasn't starving. I should tell you a little incident that happened down there. We played, we did play a job. They got one job for us, a one nighter at the Everglades. Vic Moore got it for us in Palm Beach and we were playing at this party, it was, you know, a society party. And we're playing jazz music and Joscho Heifetz was there with he (married?) was it Florence (Vidar?), I think Joscho Heifetz (Mary, Mary?). Anyway, we were playing jazz music for the dancing and Joscho Heifetz came up and stood there.…
